overview: The March 2026 launch described 220 planned apartments.
research.locationNote: West Boulevard, near Aljada’s northwest entrance. The phase-specific launch and contract releases locate Gate 5–6 here; some landing-page copy instead says East Boulevard.
research.priceNote: Arada advertises AED 970,000, also its March 2026 launch reference. Confirm a specific home’s current price and availability.
research.paymentNote: Arada publishes the schedule below, with construction instalments over two years. A September broker catalogue instead shows 5/25/70; obtain a dated unit schedule.
research.handoverNote: Arada’s March 2026 construction release targets Q2 2028 for Gate 3–6. Broker catalogues show Q4 2028. This is a forecast; confirm the contracted date.
